title.narrative: Participating in Silba’s National General Assembly 2023

description.narrative: The main content of the network activity is to give the Egyptian project group an opportunity to participate in Silba’s General Assembly and to get first-hand experience with the organization. During the assembly, the two project groups will also co-facilitate a workshop on dialogue tools for all participants. The aim of the network activity is to inspire the volunteers from The Dialogue Company and for them to see an example of how to organize voluntary work. Our intention is that the participants will receive ideas on how to incorporate work on dialogue into Silba’s and The Dialogue Company’s existing work. Furthermore, the aim of the network activity will also be the opportunity for the Egyptian and the Danish project group to meet and discuss future activities in the partnership.
